availableAtPolicy: An event may affect HESI only if it was publicly known at or before its AvailableAt timestamp. Never backfill an event as if it had been known earlier.
notes: This file is the auditable physical-event layer for Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb.
No event is added automatically unless its source, event time and AvailableAt can be defended.
An empty events array means no validated physical event has yet been entered; it does not mean physical stress is zero.
This experimental layer must not modify the official dashboard HESI until the physical methodology has been validated.
